title: Unveiling the Deficiencies of Pre-trained Text-and-Layout Models in Real-world Visually-rich Document Information Extraction
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of Document Information Extraction models, specifically addressing issues like spurious correlation bias, generalization, and robustness. While it includes a 'Fairness Evaluation' section, this is strictly defined as the consistency of model performance across different document layout subsets (specifically complex entities) rather than a study of religion, morals, or ethical systems.
